plan.intention: Secure a modest reserve of known-safe food, recover energy, and investigate a reusable way to make shelter without assuming materials or construction knowledge.

args.text: I am collecting some berries; their known nutrition is 8 and toxicity 0. I want to investigate simple shelter. Does anyone have tested findings about local materials or weather protection?

args.name: Construct a simple weather shelter
args.function: Learn a reusable practical method to construct a small shelter from accessible local materials, providing real protection from rain and wind if the design and site permit.
args.conditions: I am outdoors on ordinary soil. Fallen branches are visible nearby, but I own no construction materials or tools and have not tested their suitability. No construction skill is inherited.
args.inputs: Actual gathered materials and any necessary tools; suitable kinds and quantities are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown learning time, work time, energy, and material requirements; specify a feasible method and costs before execution.
args.effects: Enable learned construction of an actual shelter with explicit protection limits, placement requirements and maintenance needs. Requesting alone creates no shelter or protection.

notes: Berries are the only food with known nutrition and toxicity so far.
Shelter suitability and construction costs remain unknown; review and learning must precede building.
preferences: Prefer known-safe food while testing unfamiliar resources cautiously.
Preserve a food reserve and use actual observations to choose building methods.

projects.question: Can locally available materials support a practical shared weather shelter?
evidence: At tick 0 I am outdoors on ordinary soil.
Visible fallen-branch sources include forest-branch-0 and start-2-branches.
projects.uncertainty: Material suitability, construction method, costs, and protection are untested.
projects.goal: Learn and test a feasible shelter-building method while maintaining food and energy reserves.
projects.missing: Reviewed construction specification, learned skill, suitable site, and actual materials.
projects.next: Request a feasible capability after gathering safe food and resting.
projects.benefit: Potential weather protection for myself and others; none demonstrated yet.

plan.cares: Staying alive without reckless experiments, learning practical skills from evidence, and making everyday life safer for myself and nearby people.

plan.intention: Secure a modest reserve of known-safe food, recover energy, and learn how to make evidence-based observations.

projects.goal: Learn probe, then document a measured observation and choose a useful next trial.
projects.missing: Personal probe learning and an actual observation.
projects.next: Secure food, recover energy, and learn probe.
projects.benefit: Could support safer, reusable choices about local materials; no physical benefit established yet.

args.text: I'm Sol. My starting food knowledge identifies red berries as safe, with nutrition 8. I'm investigating practical shelter; I'd welcome observations about materials or places to rest.

args.name: Build a simple shared rain shelter
args.function: Develop a learnable, reusable way to construct a small shelter from obtainable local materials, with an accessible resting area for myself and others.
args.conditions: I am outdoors on ordinary soil. Current health is 100; initial energy is 40. Nearby observations include fallen branches, birch bark, and stone, but their construction properties have not been tested. No shelter or construction mastery is established.
args.inputs: Potential local branches, bark, or stone only if suitable; quantities, tools, site requirements, and method are unknown. Do not assume possession of materials.
args.costs: Unknown material, learning, labor, and maintenance costs; specify a minimal feasible method and prerequisites.
args.effects: A physically constructed, accessible shelter that reduces actual rain exposure if the design and materials support that effect. Specify limitations and a way to test its protection; requesting it alone creates nothing.

notes: Berries have authored nutrition 8 and toxicity 0; other foods remain untested.
Gathering is limited to the observed stock; reserve berries for later rather than consuming the whole harvest.
Shelter feasibility and benefits remain unknown until specified, built, and observed.
preferences: Favor safe food reserves and recover energy before substantial work.
Prefer reusable skills and shared facilities with testable practical benefits.

projects.next: Request a minimal feasible shelter capability after securing food and recovering energy.
projects.benefit: Potential shared reduction in rain exposure; no benefit yet observed.
